In-Game Description
Mastery of the techniques of the spirit fox: an awakened fox with supernatural powers.
Training Spirit Fox
Completely Normal Fox
in the
Wolf Cave
turns the player into a
Spirit Fox
and teaches
Spirit Fox
combat skill after gifting them a
Spirit Stone
.
Another way to become a
Spirit Fox
and learn the ability is to trade a
Spirit Stone
to another player who is currently a
Spirit Fox
. Once you do that, they revert to their previous form and you become a
Spirit Fox
.
Completely Normal Fox
in the
Wolf Cave
will teach the Trick Fox ability line after reaching
Spirit Fox
Level 12. (You have to have been a
Spirit Fox
for at least 24 hours.)
Mittens
in
Kur Mountains
unlocks the Level 51 - 60 and Level 61-70 skill caps.
Noita the Green
in the
Fae Realm
unlocks the Level 71-80 skill cap.
Levels 81-90 are unlocked by
Big Footed Jim
deep beneath
Povus
.
To Stop Being a Spirit Fox
There are only two ways to cease being a
Spirit Fox
. One is to have another player trade you a
Spirit Stone
, transforming them into a
Spirit Fox
and reverting you to your previous form. The other way is by drinking a
Minor Panacea
.

Related Skills:
Unarmed
- Spirit Fox and Unarmed work best as a melee-based skill set.
Warden
- Spirit Fox and Warden work very well together as combined skills, with a significant amount of possible electricity and/or fire synergy.
Necromancy
- Necromancy is possible if a Necromancy symbol is equipped (armor, clothing or jewelry only, Necro-enabled weapons do not work for this).
Priest
- Priest is possible if an Arisetsu symbol is equipped (armor, clothing, or jewelry only, Priest-enabled weapons do not work for this).
Animal Handling
- Spirit Fox and Animal Handling work well together.
Psychology
- Spirit Fox and Psychology work well together also, and is commonly used for Fox-based speed-builds.
